verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Windmill flows chain code functions written in many languages, built in a low-code builder, YAML, or workflows-as-code using ordinary TypeScript/Python constructs. That implies data can be transformed between steps with code, and branches split on conditions. But nothing in the pack documents an explicit step-to-step input mapping or expression/formula feature aimed at ops users. Missing for 10: documented step-output-to-input mapping with expressions, a formula or no-code transform option for non-developers, and hands-on corroboration of data mapping in flows.
